title: Thirteenth siege of Gibraltar
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Thirteenth siege of Gibraltar", at revision 1377209174, opens: "The thirteenth siege of Gibraltar saw Spanish forces besiege the British garrison of Gibraltar as part of the Anglo-Spanish War. Depending on the sources, Spanish troops numbered between 12,000 and 25,000. British defenders were 1,500 at the beginning of the siege, increasing up to about 5,000. After a five-month siege with several unsuccessful and costly assaults, Spanish troops gave up and withdrew. Following the failure the war drew to a close, opening the way for the 1728 Treaty of El Pardo and the Treaty of Seville signed in 1729." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q427982, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1727 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
